pr_body:
- Closes: https://github.com/moby/moby/issues/46600

Allow to load images from compressed tars.

**- How to verify it**
```diff
$ docker pull alpine
Using default tag: latest
latest: Pulling from library/alpine
579b34f0a95b: Download complete
Digest: sha256:eece025e432126ce23f223450a0326fbebde39cdf496a85d8c016293fc851978
Status: Downloaded newer image for alpine:latest
docker.io/library/alpine:latest

$ docker save alpine > alpine.tar
$ gzip <alpine.tar >alpine.tar.gz

$ docker rmi alpine
Untagged: alpine:latest
Deleted: sha256:eece025e432126ce23f223450a0326fbebde39cdf496a85d8c016293fc85197

$ docker load -i alpine.tar
Loaded image: alpine

$ docker load -i alpine.tar.gz
-archive/tar: invalid tar header
+Loaded image: alpine

```

**- Description for the changelog**
```release-note
- containerd image store: Fix `docker load` not being able to load images from compressed tar archives.
```

**- A picture of a cute animal (not mandatory but encouraged)**

issue_context.title: docker load fails with compressed image with containerd-snapshotter
issue_context.body:
### Description

docker load fails with compressed image with containerd-snapshotter.

### Reproduce

```
$ cat /etc/docker/daemon.json 
{
	"features": {
		"containerd-snapshotter": true
	}
}
```

then, run:

```
docker pull alpine
docker save alpine | gzip > alpine.tar.gz
docker rmi alpine
docker load -i alpine.tar.gz
```

### Expected behavior

alpine image should be loaded

comments:
Thanks! I opened a PR to fix this.

However, please note that with containerd integration enabled the output of `docker save` will already be compressed at the layer level because we output the original image content, so unless the image was explicitly built with uncompressed layers don't need to compress it manually anymore:

```bash
# with containerd integration enabled
$ docker save ubuntu >ubuntu.tar
$ docker save ubuntu | gzip >ubuntu.tar.gz
$ du -hs ubuntu.tar*
27M     ubuntu.tar
27M     ubuntu.tar.gz
$ file ubuntu.tar*
ubuntu.tar:    POSIX tar archive
ubuntu.tar.gz: gzip compressed data, last modified: Mon Oct  9 12:11:50 2023, from Unix, original size modulo 2^32 27361280
```

```bash
# without containerd integration
$ docker save ubuntu >ubuntu.tar
$ docker save ubuntu | gzip >ubuntu.tar.gz
$ du -hs ubuntu.tar*
81M     ubuntu.tar
28M     ubuntu.tar.gz
$ file ubuntu.tar*
ubuntu.tar:    POSIX tar archive
ubuntu.tar.gz: gzip compressed data, last modified: Mon Oct  9 12:12:22 2023, from Unix, original size modulo 2^32 71800832
```

review_comments: The only reason I can see is that this implementation doesn't support bzip2 and xz whereas Moby's does.
